component.name: krunbox
component.summary: Lightweight microVM sandboxing for AI agents and development

description.p: krunbox lets you run AI coding agents and messy code inside fast, hardware-isolated Linux microVMs. Built on crun-krun and Podman, it combines the speed of containers with real KVM kernel isolation, outbound network firewalls, and a clean native GTK4 / Libadwaita desktop interface.

ul.li: Fast Linux microVMs powered by crun-krun, libkrun, and KVM hardware virtualization
Network egress lockdown: keep agents offline or limit them to AI endpoints and dev registries
Instant SSH terminal access and 1-click launch in VS Code, Cursor, Zed, or JetBrains
Git workspace guardrails to prevent rogue scripts from planting malicious git hooks
Interactive diff viewer and 1-click rollback to inspect what agents modified
Native GTK4 and Libadwaita desktop app that fits right into GNOME

screenshot.caption: krunbox native GTK4 and Libadwaita console

description.p: Major 2.0 release featuring a native GTK4/Libadwaita console, microVM hardware isolation, egress monitoring, and 1-click IDE integration.
